tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Sections that alternate use surface-sunken.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, the navbar and sheets — anything that sits on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts and modals; always paired with a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternating page bands, table headers, inactive tracks and image placeholders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and canvas in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on canvas, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, metadata, helper text — on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions and disabled-looking metadata; still 4.5:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on ink-filled elements such as tooltips and the dark footer band.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: EasyRentSpot Spruce. Primary buttons, links, active nav, selected states. As text: on surface, canvas and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of brand fills; brand text on brand-soft for small sizes.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected chips, active list rows, info strips about the listing.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-strong fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Coral. Saved hearts, deals, 'New' and urgency moments — at most one accent moment per card.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background for accent badges and promotional strips.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Verified, approved, paid. Always with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, expiring, awaiting documents. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, rejected, overdue rent, destructive actions. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for danger badges and alerts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system notices and tips.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: rating
tokens.usage: Filled rating stars (icon, 3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring around every interactive element; 3:1 on all surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, sheets and the mobile drawer.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map placeholder ground behind MapPin.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Map placeholder water.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Find a place that feels like home
styles.usage: Home hero headline on mobile; scale to 64px/68px from lg (1024px). One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Landing and city page titles; 44px/50px from lg.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Listing title, dashboard page title; 32px/40px from lg.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings on listing and dashboard pages; 24px/32px from lg.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, modal titles, panel headings.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Sub-sections, property card titles, form group legends.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Bright corner unit with a balcony and river views.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, table cells on mobile.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above section titles; sparingly.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: Price in BookingPanel and listing header. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price on PropertyCard, StatCard values on mobile.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Booking references, invoice numbers, listing IDs.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Use the named steps only.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; between stacked metadata lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; gap inside cards on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, card padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding from md; form field stack gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tablet page gutter; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing on tablet.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tiny tags, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons (sm), menu items, table rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs at md+, alerts, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, property photos, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheets, the hero search bar, gallery mosaic.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: chips, badges, avatars, map pins, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and resting buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards, the sticky navbar.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered property cards, the search bar, map pins.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, the sticky booking panel.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets.

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first: write base styles for phones, then add min-width queries at these points.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones / small tablets portrait: 2-column listing grid.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: modals become centred dialogs, horizontal cards appear, gutters 24px.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptop: full navbar replaces menu button, BottomNav hides, 3-column grid, sticky BookingPanel, gutters 32px.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop: 4-column grid, list + map split view.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: content stays capped at container-max.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Max width of reading pages, forms and checkout.

tokens.name: navbar-height
tokens.usage: Navbar height on mobile; 72px from lg.

tokens.name: bottomnav-height
tokens.usage: Mobile BottomNav height (plus safe-area inset).

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every control on touch screens.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky navbar, sticky booking panel, StickyActionBar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal scrim and drawers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal and sheet surfaces.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
